audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Gnar, Gnar while the whys say Level 3 is 'your strongest early trade', Level 6 is HIS spike, first item is yours and late is yours. Packet chart is Skill, Gnar, Graves, Skill, Gnar, Graves, Graves.
audit.why: The mirror audit flagged this chart rather than flipping it because no counterpart existed; its notes name the intended result — Gnar owns Level 2 before Quickdraw, Graves owns Level 3 onward and from first item. This side now writes it.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Skill, Gnar, Graves, Skill, Gnar, Graves, Graves, Graves rows rated 6.5/10 and the Level 6 Gnar row 4/10, with the four affected phase whys restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] sold Level 6 as a Collateral Damage spike. Level 6 belongs to the rage bar: GNAR! is 90/60/30s and only stuns when it pins you into terrain.
audit.why: Gnar has no fixed level-6 timer — the transform is the spike, and it can arrive mid-fight.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the rage bar and the terrain condition on GNAR!'s stun; report[5] rewritten from a fake cooldown to the real read.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] carried the parenthetical 'blind stops his autos, not the boomerang ability' and report[10] said the W 'blinds tower dives'. Smoke Screen applies no blind — Riot's text is reduced sight range plus impact magic damage and a brief slow.
audit.why: Same error the mirror audit corrected on Gnar's side. It changes whether you stand in the cloud expecting his autos to miss — they will not.
audit.corrected: Both restated as vision denial plus slow. Hop's real 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s cooldown added as the concrete commit trigger the packet said was missing everywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Every commit line said 'commit on GNAR!'s cooldown', which is not a real cooldown a player can read.
audit.why: Gnar's punishable cooldown in mini form is Hop (22s at rank 1) — spent on a poke or an escape, he has no repositioning for that window.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now names Hop's 22s and what to do in that window.

audit.why: packet flagged 'His Boomerang Throw' in whys[0] as a probable wrong name — false positive; it is Gnar's real mini-form Q.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Quickdraw online: dash in, point-blank spread, bounce Q off the wall, dash out on charge two.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Six is the rage bar, not your ult — GNAR! stuns only when it pins you into terrain, so fight open ground.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: First item is yours — Eclipse tempo out-damages his itemless mini form while he is stuck short-range.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Stay glued to him: in melee his boomerang and hops do nothing, and stacked True Grit wins the duel.

edits.before: Drop W on Gnar to cut his vision range so he can't safely hop-kite away after the trade (note: blind stops his autos, not the boomerang ability)
edits.after: Drop W on Gnar to cut his vision so he can't safely hop-kite away after the trade — it is a sight cut plus a brief slow, never a blind

edits.before: Mega all-in near walls — track his rage bar like a cooldown. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Hop is 22s at rank 1 — the moment he spends it in mini form, dash in and unload before it returns.

edits.before: Track Gnar’s GNAR! (Mega): Mega all-in near walls — track his rage bar like a cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track the rage bar, not a cooldown: GNAR! stuns only when it pins you into terrain, so take every trade in open ground.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

notes: Chart flipped to match the packet and the page's own whys, and to restate the mirror's intended result (Gnar owns Level 2, Graves owns Level 3, first item and late). phases[4].rating left at 4/10 — listed only to keep the chart flip a single atomic group. Removed the false 'blind' note from wants.you[2] and the blind claim in report[10]. Answered the packet's 'no cooldown sequencing' defect with Hop's real 22s rank-1 timer. packet suspectName 'His Boomerang Throw' is a false positive.
